decisions.reason: As a flagship product prominently shown on the home page and close to the firm's established offer, high public commitment and centrality make withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Although less central than A, the firm has invested in and publicly presented this product on its own page, so escalation pressures continue to favor retention despite possible early disappointment.
Building on the firm's established offer and publicly presented on its own page, the product benefits from sunk costs and public commitment, making persistence more likely.
Distant from the established offer and thus less central, but its public presentation and invested resources still create escalation pressures that favor keeping it for now.
Similar to D, its distance from the established offer lowers centrality, yet the firm's public commitment and sunk investments make immediate withdrawal less likely.
As a flagship product line building on the established offer, it is highly visible and central to the firm's announced direction, strongly reducing the likelihood of removal.
